bayts.text: O our Lord, bless the Effacer (Al-Māḥī), who removed fear, Muḥammad; bring to pass what has gladdened me, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of Lamps, risen on high, Muḥammad, who washed away what grieved me, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of the Illuminating ones sent, Muḥammad, whose desire has been fulfilled, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of Heralds, who bestowed gifts, Muḥammad, who hastened my glad tidings, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless him whose precedence has been understood, Muḥammad, who has put to shame whoever hates me, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless him who has washed away my sloth, Muḥammad, who has honoured my odes, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the wisest of all the wise, Muḥammad, who has bound whoever challenged me, and grant peace.
Bless him who journeyed by night and ascended, upon al-Burāq, to heaven, Muḥammad; honour him with his company, and grant peace.
He spent the night piercing the layered heavens, aiming at union (with his Lord); and the Prophets, in accord, received him with honour.
They revered him, placed him foremost, honoured him and submitted to him in humility, and magnified his venerated rank.
They humbled themselves when they knew his rank, honoured meeting him and acknowledged his excellence and precedence.
They hastened (to receive him) with welcome, affability and courtesy, joy and closeness, for (the love of) his Lord who placed him foremost.
And each of them began to praise him, when he heard mention of the Intercessor of intercessors, together with the Trustworthy (Gabriel), the most eminent.
And each of them praised him, after rejoicing in his mission, and breasts expanded to give thanks for the blessings.
Then he withdrew from them and ascended, upon al-Burāq, to meet his Beloved (Allah), and passed through the veils of the Divinity, the All-Bountiful.
Then he returned to his dwelling, having obtained from Him every wish, and he removed hardship and whatever draws down retribution.
How excellent a Prophet and Messenger! How excellent he who granted us what we asked, through his Lord, the Beautiful, by his Remembrance (the Qur'an) and the Path!
The signs (wonders) of Ṭāhā, Aḥmad (Muḥammad), will never end; and the strength of the rightly guided has failed in recording them with the pen.
God sent him to all creation, reciting in measured tones a Remembrance sent down upon him, a guidance for whoever seeks knowledge.
How noble is that Book (the Qur'an)! In it are guidance and reward, in it the Word and the answer of our Lord, the Eternal.
It is the healing from every ill for whoever relies upon it; and whoever has refused it has been driven away, full of regret and remorse.
And whoever has deviated concerning it and not striven to repent will meet ruin from his Lord, the Avenger (Al-Muntaqim).
It is that through which whoever is guided by its guidance attains right guidance, and tomorrow (in the Hereafter) he will gain triumph, kept safe from punishments.
It is His clear Book, which the noble Trustworthy one (Gabriel) brought, by leave of the Lord of the worlds, a guidance for whoever embraces the most upright way.
It is that from which whoever turned away and did not ponder it has disobeyed the Lord of creation, becoming a laughingstock to those who blame.
It is that in which whoever stands firm, without turning elsewhere, doing good, will be a noble champion with the Appreciative, the Most Generous.
It is that with which whoever is content gains what suffices him, and does not meet, through (His) generosity, the torments of those who harm.
I praise my Lord for His Book, which surpasses every book revealed, with all my breast and with my mouth.
I give thanks to my Lord, the Immense, for His wise Book, and in it I have attained sciences that silence the one who stammers (in dispute).
The Book of my Lord is "the Book", according to the (Qur'anic) text "This is the Book"; through it I have been kept from reproach and from whatever brings sickness.
It (the Qur'an) is to me an intimate friend and beloved, freeing me from need of a physician; through it the wise man who seeks the best path loves me.
O best of Remembrances revealed, by the best of Lords who sent it down: lead to me the hospitality (of Paradise) from Him who possesses Permanence and Eternity.
O best of Remembrances, appearing from Him (Allah) who made my purity everlasting: make an easeful life everlasting for me, in security and in service.
You (O Qur'an) are my companion to the Gardens, O you who guard my dwelling for me, and you gladden my heart, O best of Remembrances, the perfectly established.
O best of Remembrances, recited in measure by the mouth of one who remembers and reads: drive towards others than me whoever hates me, be with me and give your judgement.
O best of Revelations, which shows to the one who ponders what was hidden: my Lord, through you, purifies my thoughts of every suspicion.
O best of Remembrances, who have gathered the most excellent sciences, and subdued my enemies for me and kept from me the harm of delusion.

You are my path and my intimate companion; you have led to me what surpasses all measure, through service to the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), the Chief, who makes me astute by (the grace of) the Inspirer (Allah).
O best of Remembrances, who erased what grieved my heart, and it was erased: grant me to be among those who succeed, by (the grace of) Him who revealed you and who gives understanding.
Through you I asked my Sovereign to be a light for the wayfarer on the Path, and an ascetic drawn by divine attraction (al-jadhb), through what is manifest and what is obscure.
and that He who brings near (Allah) may lead forever to the Prophet (Muḥammad), together with the elect, my two salutations of peace, without end and without close.
